discovery_method: Broad heat/steam name search across MJ and kg native providers, followed by exact catalog identities, production references and primary metadata inspection. Name search is discovery only, not an approved runtime matcher.

identity.name: Steam, for chemical processes, at plant
identity.reference product: Steam, for chemical processes, at plant

boundary_findings.finding: Positive 1kg steam reference. Water plus MJ burned-fuel services, not delivered heat. Preserve water and steam quantities. No one-for-one MJ relink or inferred kg/MJ factor; establish reviewed useful-heat basis before changing combustion services.

boundary_findings.name: Transport, district heat, average
boundary_findings.finding: Network infrastructure and transport energy only; primary description explicitly excludes heat supply. Do not replace with complete district delivery or add a second heat input.

boundary_findings.name: Heat, unspecific, in chemical plant
boundary_findings.finding: Positive 1MJ useful-heat/steam-energy reference; water excluded for closed-loop steam. Potential industrial-heat screening boundary; steam grade and internal electricity remain limitations to review.

boundary_findings.name: Heat, natural gas, at industrial furnace 1MW
boundary_findings.finding: Positive 1MJ useful heat at furnace, documented 95% net efficiency, no heat distribution. Candidate industrial end-use replacement at unchanged signed MJ, not fuel-input-MJ replacement.

pending_work: Select exact reviewed consumer-facing heat providers and classify industrial/buildings/district boundaries.
Protect complete native energy-generation inventories, CLIC source inventories and migration helpers from rewriting their own supply pathways.
Record every unchanged network-only, fuel-service, mass-steam and unresolved endpoint explicitly.
Resolve IAM geography with reviewed fallback; preserve quantities, uncertainty, formulas and literal originals in audit.
Verify cycles, deterministic replay and finite consumer LCIs before public callback integration.
